title: cyanus ternopoliensis
intro: Cyanus ternopoliensis, commonly known as the Ternopil Cornflower, is a plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities, helping to reduce inflammation and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to act as an antipyretic, analgesic, and anti-inflammatory agent, making it useful in treating fever, pain, and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Cyanus ternopoliensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
